note: _multitudo autem sapientium sanitas est orbis terrarum_ – the multitude of the wise is the welfare (_sanitas_) of the whole world (Douay Version). – Giuseppe Scarpat: “sanitas” come traduzione Latina di σωτηρία (Sap 6,26; 18,7). In: Núria Carduch Benages – Jacques Vermeylen (eds.): _Treasures of Wisdom_. Leuven 1999 (xxvii, 463, 7 pp.), pp. 241–253.
